# openwrt_network_device (Resource)

Manages an OpenWrt network device (bridge, bonding, etc.).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Device name (e.g., 'br-lan', 'bond0').

### Optional

- `policy` (String) Bonding policy (e.g., '802.3ad', 'active-backup').
- `ports` (List of String) Member ports (e.g., ['eth0', 'eth1']).
- `type` (String) Device type: 'bridge', 'bonding'.
- `xmit_hash_policy` (String) Bonding transmit hash policy (e.g., 'layer2+3', 'layer3+4').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: network/<device_name>.
- `section_name` (String) Internal UCI section identifier (e.g. 'cfg0abc12') of the anonymous section backing this resource. Managed automatically; resolved on import.
